text:
sam: quick heads-up — Marlin Labs reached out about a joint perf/W verification for our 13B and 70B models on their new "ML-Edge" card. they want a short, reproducible plan and a marketplace-ready blurb if numbers hold.
hana: sounds good. whats the scope? steady-state perf/W, p95 latency, and kernel stability, right?
marcus_marlin: correct. we'll provide an external powermeter trace and IPMI. firmware label ml-edge-2026-09-10, tune: ml-edge-lowpower.
sam: propose plan: two kernel configs (redwood-default, ml-edge-lowpower), one 90m run each, 15m warmup, measure last 60m. power @1s, thermal @5s. run both models sequentially.
hana: infra notes — we'll use 3 identical perf nodes in perf-pool, isolated VLAN, local collector. add a 5m calibration step at start to detect sensor drift.
marcus_marlin: we'll share a flash script and powermeter CSV endpoint. also a small validation harness that checks logits delta < 1e-4 for correctness.
violet_pm: marketing ask — include a delta vs Redwood-hosted baseline in the payload so we can craft a marketplace tile: "Optimized for Marlin ML-Edge: improved perf/W for 13B and 70B". embargo 72h after validated numbers?
sam: legal agreed to 72h embargo for joint announces. add MOU to runbook.
ops-bot: lab suggestion: 2026-09-18 20:00 PT or 2026-09-19 02:00 PT. Please confirm preferred slot.
hana: prefer 2026-09-18 20:00 PT. ops-bot: booking created: marlin-bay-5 2026-09-18T20:00:00-07:00 booking_id=MB-44711
sam: run id scheme -> RUN_ID="marlin-ml-edge-2026-09-18-01"; tags: ("marlin","perfW","ml-edge","13B","70B"). sample command I'll add to experiments/marlin/run.sh.
marcus_marlin: note: ml-edge-lowpower toggles ring-cc=on and thread_affinity=compact; we'll include toggle script.
hana: collector schema required fields: run_id, partner, model, kernel_label, firmware_id, batch_size, seq_len, tokens_per_sec, power_mean_w, power_p95_w, thermal_max_c, latency_p95_ms, raw_power_series_url, artifact_url, bench_git_sha. also kv_cache_warmup and measured_window_start/end.
sam: one gotcha — KV warmup bias. we'll strictly trim and also upload raw series so partner can re-evaluate.
violet_pm: action items: sam -> perf scripts + baseline; marcus_marlin -> powermeter + kernel scripts; hana -> infra + collector mapping; violet_pm -> comms + PR template. dry-run: 2026-09-16 09:00 PT; official: 2026-09-18 20:00 PT. post runbook link here and tag @marcus_marlin for preflight. :rocket:
